title: Back to working on the game
highlights: New Build Mode: Box Select, Axis Binding, and a bunch of new filters
Added a Mailbox that tells you about updates in-game
Rewrote gifting logic; added Mail support for future special events
Life 8 Rebirth price reduced (1Ud -> 50N), plus 2 new tiles of space
Started cleaning up the codebase

title: Bug fixes
highlights: Fixed admin abuse commands and admin abuse effects not appearing in new servers
Added serials to the Robot Apocalypse
Also added, undocumented in the original patch notes: 1 new Rebirth, 2 new Crates, and a new P2W bundle

title: New crates, ranks, rebirth, and bundle
highlights: 2 new Crates appeared with a countdown
2 new Index ranks: SIGMA and NYAN
New Rebirth
Brand new P2W Bundle
QoL: shows how many of a given crate you've unboxed
Fixed Enchanter flashing an expensive price before adjusting for a skip

title: Patches for update
highlights: New base indicator + teleport-back-to-base button
Potion crafting now increments by 5 instead of 1
Offline Earning now works
Enchant Skipping now scales off previous prices (Common 100 crystals up to Secret 2.5M)
Minefield Refiner destruction chance reduced from 50% to 30%
Ore no longer destroyed when it touches a base wall

title: Some patches, more tomorrow
highlights: Traveling Merchant is now unique per player and appears every hour instead of randomly
Fixed Electric Overdrive's and Anchor Upgrader's upgrade hitbox
Intern Dropper no longer falls apart
Added Submitter Trophies for submitters to use on their base
Reduced price of Ocean Crate to 10Oc, from 1N

title: Decorations, summer, and traveling salesman
highlights: 2 new Summer Crates with 13 new items
New Rebirth
Decorations: decorate your base with up to 10 different decorations
Traveling Salesman: Alien Items (if you missed them) plus new decoration items
New codes: auxinite, intern, sorryfordelay
New Enchanting, Unbox Slot, and Luck mastery upgrades

title: Events! Alien Invasion pt 2
highlights: New recurring event every 30 minutes, giving every player a free boost
Limited event: Alien Invasion — drops up to 4 unique items around the map
New Centering Conveyor model
Enchanting is now 1.5x faster while you're in-game
P2W/Achievement/Rebirth items removed from the Index unless you own them

title: Small balance changes
highlights: 3 new Index Tiers
Owning a Shiny Mythic now retroactively fills lower Index entries for that item
Ore Shrinker now shrinks ore by 15% (up from 2.5%)
Alien Crate price reduced to 1Sp (from 50Sp)
Chartreuse Collider capped to only upgrade ore up to 250Qn

title: Alien Update!!
highlights: 2 new Crates (12 new items) and 3 new Limited Items
New Rebirth
Teleporters added, locked behind Rebirth 5
Enchanter added — enchant any item to make it better
Crystal Comets — extra crystals fall from the sky at night
Day/night cycle added

title: Fixes
highlights: Advanced Tooltips now shows when admin abuse is starting
Settings number fields now actually let you type a number

title: Admin abuse fixes
highlights: Unaffordable crates now queue instead of blocking further unboxing
Base ore now clears when loading a layout, clearing base, or buying a plot upgrade
No longer auto-unboxes on join if you'd stopped unboxing before leaving
New icons for Ivory Solarizer and shiny Dyson Module

title: Balance + bug fixes
highlights: Cookie Upgrader, Sugar Churner, and Gumball Enchanter buffed
Chartreuse Collider now works after the Ore Wash instead of before
Fixed gamepass gifting incorrectly blocking players from receiving gifts
Netrozite Mine achievement backfilled for players who already earned it

title: Quick balance change
highlights: Forbidden Gate now costs 500K Crystals, reward reduced to 100qd (from 500qd)
Periastron Crate price reduced to 25qd (from 500qd)
Satellite Enhancer upgraded to 5M / 1.35x (up from 1M / 1.2x)
4th Rebirth price reduced to 10Qd (from 25Qn)

title: New content + base layouts!
highlights: New Crates: Space Crate (5 items) and Candy Crate (6 items), plus a new hidden Secret
New Rebirth (Life 4)
Base Layouts — save and share your base layout with friends
New Advanced Stats setting
Furnace Loot Secret chance increased from 1/1M to 1/100K

title: Admin abuse prep
highlights: Second Dragon's Breath now only destroys ore 30% of the time
Potions in inventory now sort by tier
Crystal pop-ups now correctly render the amount you're actually getting (multipliers included)
Unbox Speed gamepass now actually applies its 2x speed

title: MVP buff, gifting gamepasses, bug fixes
highlights: You can now gift gamepasses and products to other players
New MVP perks: [MVP] chat tag, 1.5x crystal multiplier (stacks with 2x Crystals for 3x total), +8 walkspeed
Chat notifications for rebirths, rare unboxes, and premium shop purchases
Crystal multiplier now correctly applies to Furnace Loot

title: New crate and furnace loot!
highlights: Furnace Loot added — earn potions and crystals for free by processing ore
New Crate discoverable somewhere on the map
New Unbox Slot Potion (+1 unbox slot for 3 minutes) and new code: MOREUNBOXES
Money cap increased to 50Qn
You can now purchase Crystals directly, unlocking the Crystalline Dropper at the top tier
